arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, controlled rear-view character reconstruction. ONE full-body STRAIGHT REAR VIEW of the EXACT Social Brave King from Image 1, using the corrected side assembly in Image 2. Image 1 controls tall proportions, massive fist/arm weight, original armor and paint. Image 2 controls the chosen triangular shoulder housing, forward engine axis, knee drill and coherent calf crawler. Image 3 is a user's green-box selection: adopt ONLY the central backpack/vertical tail-fins and rear-calf/heel design INSIDE THOSE GREEN RECTANGLES. Do NOT adopt its small hands, slender arms or short proportions. No green marks or screenshot frames. Audit each assembly as the same object seen from BEHIND: head faces AWAY, only back of crown/mane visible, no face looking over shoulder. Long orange/ivory mane sweeps naturally slightly to one side so the center pack remains readable, do not shorten it into a neck tuft. Two broad lateral bomber wings, their original graphite/ivory/orange division, correct wing roots and near-shoulder core joints retain the same height/mass as Image 1/2. Wing engines are fore-aft cylinders: from behind see restrained rear exhaust/nozzle ends, NEVER big forward intake-fan disks aimed backward. Center UPPER BACK: faithfully use Image 3's orange-framed graphite backpack, with TWO dark rounded-RECTANGULAR GRILLED openings stacked VERTICALLY, plus the slim tall orange-edged graphite tail-fin on EACH side at the rear shoulder/wing-root. Separate those rear fins from the main lateral wings; same source design, not a new enormous flight pack. Keep the black central waist/pelvis mechanics and ivory/orange hip armor, not a copied front cockpit or front crotch plate on the back. Complete core upper arms/elbows remain below shoulder housing. Forearms are huge reinforced steel fists with the same train-section outer cannon jackets as Image 1; keep actual hand/knuckle mass, not just big shells. Show the BACK/PALM-side anatomy appropriate to rear view, do not paste the front-facing knuckle plate image on the back. Train cab sections remain on the outside toward elbow, not relocated to the shoulders. Thighs retain ivory armor and articulated rear black knees. Knee drills still point FORWARD AWAY from the rear camera, so only small side silhouettes are visible as physically appropriate, no backward-pointing drills on the rear calves. Lower legs use exactly Image 3 green selection's long orange rear spine panel with a recessed dark rectangular vent, ivory upper rear plates, readable black articulated crawler bands and heel mechanism; apply same coherent construction to BOTH legs. Match Image 2's shared calf tread/wheel housing and segmented side armor; no second unrelated mini-crawler hanging at the front, no new treads on thighs. Ankles articulate under calves. Feet face AWAY: nearest ends are compact squared HEELS with a central black tread surface and orange side wheel housings as Image 3. Do not draw the front toe blocks facing the rear viewer. Same tall powerful humanoid stance, slightly separated feet, original upgraded crown/mane and gigantic fists. Crisp KINETIC_CEL linework, controlled cel shadows, ivory/orange/graphite major blocks on warm ivory background. Everything inside frame with breathing room, one machine only, no labels, arrows, text, poster marks or green boxes.
